posts.text:
Republicans have caused health insurance premiums to skyrocket for millions of hardworking taxpayers.

Why?

They don’t give a damn about the personal finances of the American people.
Statement on this morning’s congressional oversight visit to notorious ICE detention center Delaney Hall.

Just completed a congressional oversight visit with members of the New Jersey delegation.

Delaney Hall should be shut down.

This is not America.

Video

Thank you @RepBeatty for fighting for the Kennedy Center.

Enough with the presidential graffiti from the Trump administration.

The Kennedy Center belongs to the American people.

A federal court has stopped the Trump administration from going forward with its corrupt $1.8 billion slush fund.

We will keep the pressure on these extremists.

And protect your taxpayer dollars from Republican waste, fraud and abuse.

Taxpayer dollars should be used to make life more affordable.

Not brutalize and kill American citizens or violently target law-abiding immigrant families.

We strongly oppose the ICE budget reconciliation bill.

And will do everything we can to defeat it next week.

Hard No on a Trump $250 bill.

Get over yourself.

The upcoming July 4th anniversary is not about a wannabe King.

It’s about celebrating the American journey.

The affordability crisis is not a hoax and the American people know it.

You deserve better.

Groceries cost too much, gas prices are draining wallets and healthcare bills are impossible to pay.

Isn’t it time we put everyday Americans first?

The Trump revenge tour continues in Texas today.

Meanwhile.

The Republican economy continues to fall apart.

And the extremists have done nothing to make your life better.

Deeply grateful for the men and women of the U.S. Military who made the ultimate sacrifice.

To defend our freedom and the American way of life.

Our nation is forever in your debt.

Republicans own this reckless war of choice in Iran.

And the out of control gas prices crushing the American people.

You deserve better.
Gas is over $4.50 per gallon, families are hurting and Republicans don’t give a damn.

Conservative extremists on the Supreme Court gave Donald Trump King-like immunity in 2024.

They are responsible for the unprecedented corruption he's unleashed on the country.

And now the American people are paying the price.

We will always stand with Stephen Colbert.

Video

Donald Trump pardoned hundreds of violent felons who brutally beat police officers on January 6th.

Now he wants to pay them with a nearly $2 billion slush fund using taxpayer money.

Everyone involved in this crooked scheme will be held accountable.
